technicalJsonField.contents: same small bounded work-group descriptor/identity, first-last operation IDs/ordinals, predecessor linkage, opaque descriptor digest and current-group facts
technicalJsonField.placement: each existing operation's original immutable audit and receipt, inserted together; CORE/INIT carries root identity too; no added trace rows or table/column

technicalJsonField.atomicity: deferred commit guards require complete declared group range and all operations same actual current transaction; last-only marker v1 proposal superseded

boundedRead.input: identity existing six fields plus rootOperationId, exact bounded descriptor plus firstOperationId/lastOperationId/previousLastOperationId/previousDescriptorSha256
boundedRead.output: fixed state/subBatchId/descriptorSha256/summary below64KiB; summary only final reconciliation where applicable
boundedRead.state: inspect locked ABSENT or COMMITTED; complete only PENDING_TRANSACTION, durable success only COMMIT ACK or new locked inspect
boundedRead.locks: existing cutoff then stable subBatchId lock and original actor/request lock consistent order; pending prior COMMIT waits or UNKNOWN timeout
boundedRead.comparison: exact JSONB descriptor/original request; opaque JS hash only binding, PG verifies own hash; predecessor PK/root/input binding required
